clue.text: Moist fine-grained earth in small measure — just the opposite

indicators.text: in small measure — just the opposite

parts.note: clay is soil made of very fine particles
mm, the millimetre, is a tiny unit of length

explanation.surface: A soil scientist describes a damp sample of fine soil, measured in small quantities.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, the earth would sit inside the measure; 'just the opposite' reverses which piece holds which.
explanation.definitionFit: Clammy describes something unpleasantly damp and sticky to the touch, a close synonym.

clue.text: Fellow not born sharp-witted

clue.text: John Pilger's one friend possesses interminable spirit

explanation.walkthrough: John Pilger was an Australian investigative journalist; 'one' turns him into an example, one such journalist exposing scandal.
